grammar_card.title: 怎么选时态——看语境和时间状语(复习)
grammar_card.intro: 本课把前面学过的时态语态放在一起复习。挑时态的关键不是背规则,而是看句子说的是什么时候、什么样的事。全用本课句子举例。

headers: 什么时候 / 什么样的事
用哪个时态 · 本课例子
rows: 此刻 / 现阶段正在进行
现在进行(is/are + doing):He is now working at a bank.
通常 / 反复发生的习惯
一般现在(do/does):He gets a good salary but always borrows money.
过去某个时间完成的动作
一般过去(did):Tony walked in. / He gave me the money.
到现在为止的经历 / 影响
现在完成(has/have + done):He has never borrowed money from me.
过去进行(was/were + doing):While he was eating, I asked him…

specialRules.rule: '某物被…'用被动语态(be + 过去分词),是前面第10课学的,本课一起复习
选时态先找时间信号:now→现在进行 · always/every day→一般现在 · years ago→一般过去 · never/so far→现在完成 · when/while + 过去→过去进行

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Who paid for the writer's dinner?
options: The writer did (Tony turned it around)

passage: I was having dinner at a downtown restaurant when Tony Steele walked in. Tony worked in a lawyer's office years ago, but he is now working at a bank. He gets a good salary, but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back. Tony saw me, and he came over and sat down at my table. He has never borrowed a single dollar from me before. While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty dollars. To my surprise, he handed me the money immediately. "I have never borrowed any money from you," Tony said with a smile. "So now you can pay for my dinner!" I looked at the check on the table and could not help laughing. One good turn deserves another, I guess.

stage5.stem: "To my surprise, he ___ me the money immediately."(give,过去完成的动作)

stage5.stem: "Listen! Someone ___ at the door."(Listen!，此刻正在)

stage5.stem: "He gets a good salary, ___ he always borrows money."(前后相反，转折)

stage5.stem: "Now you can pay for my dinner!" —— 前因后果,'所以'用:

stage5.stem: ask sb ___ sth（请某人做某事）,'某人'后面的动作用:
"I asked him ___ me twenty dollars."(ask sb to do)
